dashboard.cost.basis: Labour (net pay of wage sheets ending in the period) + approved petty cash expenses excluding WAGES + materials used on approved shift reports valued at the latest receipt unit cost, divided by good blocks.
dashboard.kpi.achievement.definition: Blocks produced ÷ shift target × 100 (approved shift reports).
dashboard.kpi.achievement.label: Production achievement
dashboard.kpi.availability.definition: (Planned time − downtime) ÷ planned time × 100. Planned time = {minutes} min per approved shift report.
dashboard.kpi.availability.label: Machine availability
dashboard.kpi.blocksSold.definition: Quantity on CONFIRMED sales dated in the period.
dashboard.kpi.blocksSold.label: Blocks sold
dashboard.kpi.cementPer1000.definition: Cement bags used (approved shift reports) ÷ blocks produced × 1,000.
dashboard.kpi.cementPer1000.label: Cement per 1,000 blocks
dashboard.kpi.collected.definition: Customer payments dated in the period (confirmed sales).
dashboard.kpi.collected.label: Cash collected
dashboard.kpi.costPerBlock.definition: (Labour cost + petty cash expenses excluding WAGES + materials used × latest receipt unit cost) ÷ good blocks.
dashboard.kpi.costPerBlock.label: Cost per good block
dashboard.kpi.good.label: Good blocks
dashboard.kpi.labourCost.definition: Net pay of wage sheets (status Prepared or later) whose period ends within the range.
dashboard.kpi.labourCost.label: Labour cost
dashboard.kpi.pettyCashBalance.definitio: Approved deposits − approved expenses − MoMo charges, as at the end of the period.
dashboard.kpi.pettyCashBalance.label: Petty cash balance
dashboard.kpi.pettyCashExpenses.definiti: Approved petty cash expenses dated in the period (incl. MoMo charges).
dashboard.kpi.pettyCashExpenses.label: Petty cash expenses
dashboard.kpi.produced.definition: Total blocks on approved shift reports.
dashboard.kpi.produced.label: Blocks produced
dashboard.kpi.quality.definition: Good blocks ÷ blocks produced × 100. Good = produced − damage (production) − damage (handling) − samples.
dashboard.kpi.quality.label: Quality acceptance rate
dashboard.kpi.receivables.definition: All confirmed sales − all payments received, as at the end of the period.
dashboard.kpi.receivables.label: Receivables outstanding
dashboard.kpi.rejection.definition: (Damage in production + damage in handling) ÷ blocks produced × 100.
dashboard.kpi.rejection.label: Rejection rate
dashboard.kpi.revenue.definition: Value of CONFIRMED sales dated in the period.
dashboard.kpi.revenue.label: Sales revenue
